name: remotion-viz-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Remotion video rendering and SVG/HTML visualization rasterization

scripts.test: node --test test/unit.test.mjs test/protocol.test.mjs test/process-leak.test.mjs test/audit.test.mjs test/dashboard.test.mjs test/audit-isolation.test.mjs test/limits.test.mjs test/timeouts.test.mjs test/html.test.mjs test/studio.test.mjs test/engines.test.mjs test/version-sync.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage test/unit.test.mjs test/protocol.test.mjs test/process-leak.test.mjs test/audit.test.mjs test/dashboard.test.mjs test/audit-isolation.test.mjs test/limits.test.mjs test/timeouts.test.mjs test/html.test.mjs test/studio.test.mjs test/engines.test.mjs test/version-sync.test.mjs

plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: node -e "const c=require('./package.json').version,n='${nextRelease.version}',p=v=>v.split('.').map(s=>s.padStart(6,'0')).join('.');if(p(n)<=p(c)){console.error('Refusing to release '+n+': package.json already states '+c+'. semantic-release derives the next version from git tags and this repository has none, so it restarts at 1.0.0 and would publish a downgrade. Tag the commit that shipped '+c+' as v'+c+', push the tag, then re-run.');process.exit(1)}"
plugins.prepareCmd: node scripts/sync-version.mjs ${nextRelease.version} && npm run build && npm run bundle && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs
